blockers.title: connect upserts event_sync_jobs with an unresolvable onConflict arbiter
blockers.severity: correctness, latent; fail-closed with 500 on a route that is currently capability-gated
blockers.diagnosis: Route: `await service.from("event_sync_jobs").upsert({ provider: "bandsintown", job_type: "verify_connection", dedupe_key: `bandsintown:verify:${connection.id}`, payload: { connectionId: connection.id }, status: "queued", priority: 50, updated_at: ... }, { onConflict: "dedupe_key" })` at app/api/integrations/bandsintown/connect/route.ts:60-71. Data API rendering: `insert into public.event_sync_jobs (provider, job_type, dedupe_key, payload, status, priority, updated_at) values (...) on conflict (dedupe_key) do update set updated_at = excluded.updated_at returning id, status`. Schema: `create unique index if not exists idx_event_sync_jobs_dedupe_active on public.event_sync_jobs (dedupe_key) where status in ('queued','running') and dedupe_key is not null;` (transcribed from the archived file at :116-118). PostgreSQL arbiter inference SKIPS a partial unique index entirely unless the statement carries an arbiter `WHERE` implying the index predicate; the query's own WHERE is not used for inference. MEASURED, in both directions so the fault is not misattributed: (a) the exact connect-route statement returns SQLSTATE 42P10 and writes nothing; (b) the SAME statement with `on conflict (dedupe_key) where status in ('queued','running') and dedupe_key is not null` resolves and returns the row; (c) a second ACTIVE job on one key is rejected with 23505 on idx_event_sync_jobs_dedupe_active; (d) the same key IS accepted again once the first job left queued/running; (e) three dedupe_key IS NULL jobs are all storable. So the index is correct and the route's statement form is wrong.
blockers.why_not_repaired: The database lane does not own this route, and the one schema change that WOULD make it resolve is a measured semantic regression (see OB-1.why_not_repaired in the manifest and the manifest's assumptions[1]). Silently adding `create unique index on public.event_sync_jobs (dedupe_key)` would make the green gate stay green and the queue wrong: a second `connect` for the same connection would fail on a completed job, and a `dead` job could never be re-enqueued. That is the failure mode this lane exists to stop.
blockers.precedent_in_repo: lib/ticketing/analytics.ts:66-80 already handles the IDENTICAL pattern correctly: the ticketing lane's `create unique index if not exists idx_ticket_analytics_events_dedupe_key on public.ticket_analytics_events (dedupe_key) where dedupe_key is not null` (migration 20260927120000) is also partial, and the code deliberately uses a plain `insert` and interprets 23505 as the intended outcome rather than relying on ON CONFLICT inference. `__tests__/ticketing/issuance-slot-dedup-migration-contract.test.ts:57` pins that shape. So this repository already knows partial unique indexes are not ON CONFLICT arbiters; the connect route is the one place that got it wrong.
blockers.requested_action: integrations, on INTG-008: apply the ROUTE-SIDE fix, which is the preferred and smallest one — replace the upsert with a select-then-insert-or-update on `dedupe_key` scoped to `status in ('queued','running')`, or catch 23505 and update the existing active job, mirroring `lib/ticketing/analytics.ts`. Do NOT add a full unique index on `dedupe_key` without an explicit owner decision, because it makes a dedupe key single-use forever. If a raw RPC is ever introduced for the enqueue, the arbiter-WHERE form is the shape that resolves. Record the chosen shape in the route so the next reader knows the arbiter is partial on purpose.

title: The connect route upserts event_sync_jobs with an onConflict arbiter that cannot resolve against the archived partial unique index (measured SQLSTATE 42P10)
summary: DB-021 authored supabase/migrations/20260927140100_event_sync_jobs.sql from supabase/migration-archive/pre-reconciliation-local-only-2026-08-20/20260804130000_event_provider_foundation.sql:95-113 and :116-126. The schema is now correct and complete. MEASURED DEFECT IN A ROUTE THIS LANE DOES NOT OWN: app/api/integrations/bandsintown/connect/route.ts:70 upserts with `{ onConflict: "dedupe_key" }`, which the Supabase Data API renders as a bare `ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) DO UPDATE`. The archived arbiter, idx_event_sync_jobs_dedupe_active, is a PARTIAL unique index (`where status in ('queued','running') and dedupe_key is not null`), and PostgreSQL will not infer a partial unique index as an ON CONFLICT arbiter unless the statement supplies the index predicate as an arbiter WHERE clause, which PostgREST cannot emit. Executed on a throwaway PostgreSQL 16.15, the exact connect-route statement returns SQLSTATE 42P10, "there is no unique or exclusion constraint matching the ON CONFLICT specification". The database lane did NOT change the index, because the only DDL that would make the route's bare arbiter resolve is a FULL unique index on dedupe_key, and that was measured to be wrong: it converts "one ACTIVE job per dedupe key" into "one job per dedupe key FOREVER", so a connection could never be re-verified (the route keys `bandsintown:verify:${connection.id}`) and a `dead` job could never be re-enqueued. The index is transcribed as archived and the route-side fix is routed here. The defect is LATENT, not an outage: connect is still 503 behind the disabled `external_event_providers` capability, so this is the NEXT failure the moment that capability is enabled, and it should not be discovered then. This is the second of the two missing relations from the one archived file; DB-020 restored the first and routed this one, and after both files NO route opens — for this reason and because event_sync_runs is still absent (HF-DB021-EVENT-SYNC-RUNS).
